services.name: Cooking Classes
services.desc: Whether you’re married, dating or simply friends, our cooking classes are kinda like going out to dinner… but with the twist that you’ll be preparing the meal and learning skills along the way. It’s a great way to expand your horizons and simply have fun!Our chefs will guide you through the menus in an interactive way. While not intimidating for the novice, they will still challenge those who already know their way around the kitchen. At the end of the class everyone will sit together and enjoy the fruits of our labour.It’s an unhurried, low stress and entertaining atmosphere for anyone. quotes.text: A fun, informative and tasty experience! Great date night or birthday gift idea.

Aphrodite Cooks is THE place for cooking classes. I've taken both the "Cooking with Coffee" class and the "Knife Skills" class. Each class I learned new things and left with recipes that I regularly use. Vanessa and the crew know about food and create a wonderful food experience!

Attended an in-person Valentine's event with friends at Aphrodite Cooks. Was a perfect blend of instruction/learning with a fun dining and social experience. Like attending/hosting a dinner party without having to do all the work, and the party always ends up in the kitchen anyhow. Vanessa kept everyone engaged, and led a great event.

Dumplings for duos was so much fun. For us to celebrate our 16th wedding anniversary & early Valentine’s Day. Everything was delicious! Will be easy to do at home with the recopies! Thank you so much for another amazing experience & evening!! We will be back again!!!
Excellent class with exceptional food and service. Made for a delightful evening. Highly recommended.

Excellent class with gluten-free and lactose-free menu options. Vanessa was lovely and led us through the class seamlessly. The food was so delicious. Can't wait to go back for more classes in the future!

Finesse the owner is an excellent teacher and was able to get everyone involved no matter what age or ability of cooking they came to the class with. The class had a great variety and new twists on old recipes. Definitely a worthwhile experience!

Friends, if you are looking for a really great dinner and fun night - look no further than an Aphrodite Cooks Cooking class. Chef Vanessa is amazing coach and will teach you so much about cooking. We throughly enjoyed the process and she took her time to give all the instruction we needed. The food was Amazing! Do yourself a favour and order the food ahead of time so you have everything you need. Sign up today you won't regret it.
Highly highly recommend the cooking classes. SO much fun, delicious & you learn so much!

I attended a gluten free baking class recently and it was wonderful. The space is a gorgeous kitchen and the class was really helpful, interesting and I went home with some tasty gluten free treats. Kimberly and Vanessa were both extremely helpful and full of advice. Gluten free snacks and drinks before the class were a great touch. I'd highly recommend their classes and love the space.
I did an Italian pasta cooking class with my daughter and it was amazing! The food was delicious and it was a really great experience. Thank you Vanessa!

I had the pleasure of attending a dinner party Aphrodite Cooks was catering and the food was delicious!!! Coffee crusted beef tenderloin, maple and grainy mustard salmon, Gruyere potato gratin were a few highlights of this wonderful meal. I highly recommend Vanessa and look forward to enjoying more of her amazing food.
